summary: Shows triggering imported handlers by notifying individual task names from the imported file, since the import name no longer exists at runtime.
questions: How do I notify a specific handler from an imported file?
Why doesn't notifying an import_tasks handler name work?

answer_card.title: Triggering imported (static) handlers
answer_card.answer_md:
With an import, the import's name doesn't exist at runtime, so notify the tasks inside:

```yaml
handlers:
  - name: Restart services
    import_tasks: restarts.yml
tasks:
  - command: "true"
    notify: Restart apache
  - command: "true"
    notify: Restart mysql
```
